verdict.rationale: Finix documents a dedicated 'Monetizing Payments' guide for platforms and lists fee customizations such as fees per payment method, volume discounts and international charges. Fee schemas can be configured in the test environment, and automated reports cover fees. This supports taking a cut on transactions, but the evidence never explicitly confirms per-seller pricing or revenue reported separately from processing costs. Missing for 10: explicit per-seller pricing configuration, an explicit application-fee/markup mechanism, reporting that separates platform revenue from processing costs, independent corroboration.
